Slow.name: Slow
Slow.description: Reduces target speed by 3 and lowers defense.

Stone Skin.name: Stone Skin
Stone Skin.description: Increases a friendly stack's defense by 3.

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.description: Shakes the battlefield, damaging enemy walls.

Implosion.name: Implosion
Implosion.description: Crushes a single stack for 300+ damage.

Haste.name: Haste
Haste.description: Increases a friendly stack's speed by 3.

Lightning Bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
Lightning Bolt.description: Strikes one stack for 25 x power damage.

Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning.description: Lightning that jumps to 4 targets, halving each jump.

Dimension Door.name: Dimension Door
Dimension Door.description: Teleports the hero to a nearby tile on the adventure map.

Curse.name: Curse
Curse.description: Enemy stack always deals minimum damage.

Bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
Bloodlust.description: Increases a friendly stack's melee attack by 3.

Fireball.name: Fireball
Fireball.description: Explodes on a hex and its neighbors for 25 x power damage.

Armageddon.name: Armageddon
Armageddon.description: Rains fire on ALL stacks for 50 x power damage.

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.description: A great firestorm dealing 100 fire damage in a wide area.

Bless.name: Bless
Bless.description: Friendly stack always deals maximum damage.

Weakness.name: Weakness
Weakness.description: Reduces an enemy stack's attack by 3.

Frost Ring.name: Frost Ring
Frost Ring.description: Ring of ice around a hex for 10 x power damage.

Blizzard.name: Blizzard
Blizzard.description: Freezing storm: 10 x power damage and slows the area.

Resurrection.name: Resurrection
Resurrection.description: Revives 50 x power HP of fallen friendly units.
